title: Private Idol Disc: Tokubetsu-hen: Cosplayers
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ 【特別編】 ～コスプレイヤーズ～
overview:
Packed with the appeal of cosplayers

Cosplayers

Starting today, you too are a cosplay connoisseur!!

This special edition of the Private Idol Disc series is a photo collection devoted to cosplayers dressed as popular characters. In the Photo Hall you pick the pictures you want to see by character or by cosplayer. The Video Hall holds short movies of the cosplayers, and the disc also takes you along to a cosplay party.

- Photo Hall: browse photos by character or by cosplayer
- Video Hall: short video clips
- Bonus: a versus fighting mini game where the cards you draw decide your attacks and defense
- Production credits

コスプレイヤーの魅力満載

コスプレイヤーズ

今日からあなたもコスプレ通!!
